spirit_first_adjacency: You came. I didn't think anyone still walked this far for a name.
Someone remembers me. I'd almost forgotten what that felt like.
You're close now. I can feel the thread again, just barely.
Ah — a living hand, near mine. It's been so long.
spirit_escort_start: Walk with me, then. The road home is longer than it looks.
Stay close. I lose myself when I'm alone too long.
Lead, and I'll follow — my feet remember the way, if my mind doesn't.
Together, then. One more thread pulled back from the dark.
spirit_guide_win: Home. I'm home. Thank you for not letting go of me.
The thread holds again. I am whole enough to rest.
This is the place. I remember it now — I remember myself.
You carried a stolen story all this way. I won't forget it.
spirit_killed: No — not again. Not so close to—
The thread... it's slipping. Tell them I tried to come home.
Let the next one find the road easier than I did.
